description: This Java class defines the FloatingRate entity in a financial application, including its properties, constructors, creation and update methods, and logic for managing floating interest rate periods.

classes.name: FloatingRate
classes.description: Entity representing a floating interest rate configuration, including periods and properties indicating if it is active or a base rate.

methods.name: FloatingRate
methods.description: Constructor initializing FloatingRate with name, base rate flag, active flag, and rate periods.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a FloatingRate from a JsonCommand.

methods.name: getRatePeriods
methods.description: Extracts and creates FloatingRatePeriod objects from JSON data within a command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of the FloatingRate based on a JsonCommand, including rate periods.

methods.name: updateRatePeriods
methods.description: Updates the list of rate periods, deactivating future periods and adding new ones.

methods.name: fetchInterestRates
methods.description: Fetches applicable interest rate periods based on a FloatingRateDTO object.
